records.text: Citing unnamed sources, Owens alleged that an unnamed doctor who treated Kirk at Timpanogos recused himself during or immediately after surgery following a disagreement and asked to have his name removed from related records.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Something else I'm going to mention to you guys today is there is a doctor. At Timpanogos Hospital who worked on Charlie (Charlie Kirk). ... I'm not going to name the doctor today. ... But we have learned that there was allegedly a disagreement during or immediately after the surgery where this doctor felt the need to recuse himself and completely remove himself from the situation altogether. ... I mean, he asked to have all of his name removed from anything to do with it off all of the records and anything that was related to what transpired on September. ... On September 10th, he apparently is in a weird state about whatever went down. He is, I am told, out of character in that regard and gets very uncomfortable and weird when anybody asks him about what happened, which led to him recusing himself from the operation room. ... Wanted to be removed from all paperwork. Why would that be? Just putting that out there. We are going to follow up on that story, but I wanted you guys to know that Timpanogos seems like a weird place.
